newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices - Jan 27.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices - Jan 27.

text.p: DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

-------- COMMENTS - Bunkers edged up after shipowners emerged to cover requirements, traders said. A major said sales were concluded at $103.50 and $104 per tonne for 380-cst, up from last Friday amid healthy enquiries. "Shipowners were caught as they expected prices to fall further but they rose instead," the major said. --Singapore Newsroom (+65-870-3082)
